title: Figure Hierarchy
description: Create a class Figura with a name and a method calcularArea() that returns 0. Then create Circulo extends Figura with a radius and Rectangulo extends Figura with base and height, both overriding calcularArea().
hints: Figura is the parent class; Circulo and Rectangulo are the subclasses
Use super("nombre") in the subclass constructors
Override with the same signature: double calcularArea()
solutionExplanation: Inheritance lets Figura describe any shape. Each subclass computes its own area with an override.

title: Employee and Manager
description: Create an Empleado class with a name, a base salary and a method calcularSalario() that returns the base salary. Then create Gerente extends Empleado with a bonus and override calcularSalario() by adding the bonus.
hints: The Gerente constructor must call super(nombre, salarioBasico) first
The calcularSalario() override adds salarioBasico + bono
You can assign Gerente to an Empleado variable (upcasting)
solutionExplanation: Gerente inherits from Empleado and adds a bonus. The override adds the bonus to the base salary.

title: Vehicle Hierarchy
description: Create a complete vehicle hierarchy: Vehiculo (marca, anio), Auto extends Vehiculo (puertas, combustible) and Camioneta extends Vehiculo (cargaMax, traccion). Both subclasses override mostrarInfo() using super.mostrarInfo() and add their own info. Create a Vehiculo array with both types and iterate over it showing the info.
hints: Use super.mostrarInfo() in each subclass to avoid duplicating code
The Vehiculo array enables polymorphism with Auto and Camioneta
Override getTipo() to identify each subclass
solutionExplanation: Inheritance with super.mostrarInfo() reuses the parent's code. The Vehiculo array demonstrates polymorphism: each type shows its own specific info.
expectedOutput:
Type: Auto
Toyota | Year: 2023
Doors: 4 | Fuel: Gasolina

Type: Camioneta
Ford | Year: 2022
Max load: 1500.0 kg | Traction: 4x4
